fact_text: The CEO said Haleon was formed by merging the consumer health businesses of GSK, Novartis and Pfizer, and that the listed Pakistan company was earlier named GSK Consumer Healthcare.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)

fact_text: The CEO said Haleon's Pakistan portfolio includes OTC brands such as Panadol, Centrum, Sensodyne and Eno, and claimed the company is the largest OTC self-care firm in Pakistan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)

fact_text: Prescription medicines such as antibiotics and oncology drugs are dispensed only on a prescription, while over-the-counter self-care products such as pain relievers and toothpaste can be bought without one.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)

fact_text: The CEO said the government kept prices of essential medicines regulated (about 472 on the WHO essential list) and deregulated non-essential ones; nutraceuticals and herbal products were never price-regulated.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)

fact_text: Plain paracetamol is on the WHO essential medicines list, while Panadol Extra adds caffeine to paracetamol, which puts that combination in the non-essential category.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)

fact_text: Active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) are made from petrochemical raw materials that start at naphtha cracker output, so local API production depends on investment across the whole downstream chain.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)

fact_text: The CEO said API manufacturing is harder than formulation because it needs large scale and skilled staff, and many vitamin ingredients are still imported rather than made in Pakistan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)

fact_text: In formulation, one factor such as humidity can spoil whole batches of powder or tablets, the CEO said, so a single process failure can cause large production losses.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)

fact_text: The CEO said Panadol production was halted and announced under force majeure because its cost of production was higher than its maximum retail price (MRP).
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)

fact_text: The CEO said making Panadol ingredients and self-care products locally, instead of importing them, would let Haleon price below imported equivalents, improve profitability and reduce reliance on foreign exchange.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)

fact_text: The CEO said locally made Haleon products meet the same quality standard as those made in Italy or the US, with zero tolerance for quality differences.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)

fact_text: In April 2025, Haleon Pakistan made its first Sensodyne toothbrush in Pakistan, a soft-bristle brush with a smaller head built to international quality standards, the CEO said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)

fact_text: As of 2025-04-29 Haleon Pakistan exported to four to five countries, and its first Centrum export, the Immunity and Mobility variants, was a pilot shipment to Kenya, the CEO said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)

fact_text: The CEO said Haleon Pakistan aims to export to nearly 19 countries, with product registrations planned over 12 to 18 months, and that each country's registration is a long process.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)

fact_text: The CEO said exports were a single-digit share of Haleon Pakistan's total sales, and the company does not disclose export share targets as a listed entity because of price-sensitive information.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)

fact_text: The CEO said Haleon Pakistan had contract-manufacturing capacity of about 5 billion tablets at one manufacturer and about 1 billion tablets at another, for Panadol production.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)

fact_text: The CEO said Panadol variants together sell about 6 billion tablets a year in Pakistan, and that capacity bottlenecks could arise at that volume.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)

fact_text: The CEO said the company spent about USD 2 million on the CAC 1000 Plus vitamin line, a capacity investment alongside its paracetamol and Panadol plant spending at Jamshoro.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)

fact_text: The CEO said investment at the Jamshoro plant for paracetamol and Panadol, plus the CAC vitamin line, should raise Haleon Pakistan's capacity by about 50%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)

fact_text: The CEO said the company stopped producing black Iodex in 2017 over environmental concerns, but old black-Iodex stock remains on shop shelves and regulators still write to the company about it.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)

fact_text: The CEO said when a product is out of stock, unofficial or counterfeit versions tend to appear in the market, so stronger enforcement is needed alongside government coordination.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)

fact_text: The CEO said when the rupee comes under pressure, imported APIs become costlier and medicine prices rise, so the cycle continues unless API manufacturing is built locally.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)

fact_text: The CEO said India's pharmaceutical exports rose by USD 4 billion year on year, from USD 38 billion to USD 42 billion, in the fiscal year FY25.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)

fact_text: The CEO said Haleon Pakistan was the largest multinational pharmaceutical exporter from Pakistan in 2024, without giving export figures in the interview.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)

fact_text: The CEO said Pakistan's population of about 250 million makes it an attractive market for multinational pharma investment once price deregulation takes effect.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)

fact_text: The CEO said multinational pharma firms held back investment in Pakistan while prices were regulated, and that investment should return as pricing conditions and enforcement improve.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)

fact_text: Centrum was registered in Pakistan as a medicine in 1981, when Wyeth owned it, although it belongs in the supplement or vitamin category, which created legal issues, the CEO said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)

fact_text: The CEO said resolving the regulatory challenges on Centrum's classification took about two and a half years.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)

fact_text: The CEO said Centrum's first phase is importing its adult and silver halal variants in smaller packs and at a lower price than grey-channel stock, with cold-chain integrity assured.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)

fact_text: The CEO said Centrum's later phases are gender-specific men's and women's variants, and targeted products for calcium, folic acid, zinc and iron deficiency, made in Pakistan for local and export markets.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)

fact_text: The CEO said exporters send dossier samples to labs abroad, such as in Singapore, for FDA-level testing, and suggested an accepted independent local lab would cut time and cost for exports.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)

fact_text: Panadol Regular was launched in Pakistan in 1976 and Panadol Extra in 1991, and Pakistani consumers had no other Panadol variants until the newer ones were added.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)

fact_text: The CEO said Panadol Extend, Panadol Night and Panadol Ultra were launched in the three years up to 2025, and Panadol menstrual-pain and migraine variants are expected soon.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)

fact_text: The CEO said Haleon Pakistan supplied all its toothpaste stock for the Qatar football World Cup, where demand lasted two months.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Haleon Pakistan To Expand Horizons With Exports to 19 Countries Planned | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-29)
